verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. In both, the headline fills the banner height with almost no top or bottom margin. The windmill icon, which was the focal image in the original, is shrunk to a barely visible speck in the far right corner. The red and blue triangles and the diagonal lines are crammed together around the icon on the right, while the green triangle floats on its own at the left. The result is a lopsided, cluttered right side and a weak icon instead of a deliberate left-to-right banner layout.
